mechanism: Estradiol inhibits CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, reducing nortriptyline metabolism and increasing tricyclic antidepressant plasma concentrations, while nortriptyline may increase estradiol metabolism via CYP3A4 induction.
action: Monitor for increased nortriptyline adverse effects (anticholinergic, cardiac, CNS); consider nortriptyline dose reduction or therapeutic drug monitoring if estradiol dose is initiated or increased.
